items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That was with Louis Keough. That was the uncle I guess of your teacher. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, that's the one you all want to interview. No, this is a different Louis.

ctx.x: On that mouthpiece. And he also used to get tips for himself when he'd get through playing and the actors would come in at Anderson and he'd play for them to sing and they'd tip him to play.
I believe Professor Mineta was who told us how he played at the old tuxedo dance hall too. Oh, yes. Fantastic. That was with Louis Keough. That was the uncle I guess of your teacher. That's poor.
Well, that's the one you all want to interview. No, this is a different Louis.
